description: In front of you on a green tablecloth are several piles of colorful plastic beads, a dark cup, and a black cord lying across the table. The right hand holds the cord end and brings it over the bead piles while the left hand reaches down to pick up a single bead, then moves toward the cord; both hands meet as the bead is aligned with the cord and threaded on, with the left hand releasing the bead once it’s on and the right hand keeping tension on the cord.
